What are templates and why do I need to use one?

Project templates offer predefined configurations for both single and multiple mining projects. They include activity definitions, breakdowns, approvals, and other essential process mining details. Since projects are frequently repeated, templates provide a convenient way to create, save, and reuse project structures. You can easily customize existing templates, generate projects based on them, and apply templates to empty projects.
